message.content: {"rules":["Both `x` and `y` must be valid for both reads and writes of `count * size_of::<T>()` bytes.","Both `x` and `y` must be properly aligned for `T`, even when `count * size_of::<T>()` is zero.","The memory region beginning at `x` of size `count * size_of::<T>()` bytes must not overlap the memory region beginning at `y` of the same size.","The data in the regions may be uninitialized or otherwise violate the requirements of `T`.","The initialization state of the swapped data is preserved exactly."]}
